CheckTitle: OBS bucket ACL does not grant permissions to Everyone
Description: **Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)** bucket **Access Control Lists (ACLs)** do not grant read, write, or ACL modification permissions to the `Everyone` user group.
Risk: Granting **OBS bucket ACL** permissions to `Everyone` exposes the bucket to anonymous internet users, allowing unauthorized listing, reading, modification, or deletion of stored data and **confidentiality** breaches.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Object Storage Service (OBS)**.
3. Select the target **bucket**.
4. In the navigation pane, choose **Permissions** > **Bucket ACLs**.
5. Remove all permissions assigned to the **Anonymous Users (Everyone)** group.
6. Click **Save**.

Recommendation.Text: Remove all `Everyone` grants from **OBS bucket ACLs** and manage access strictly through **IAM** and least-privilege bucket policies.
